title: VIX futures & options January expiration (SOQ settlement)
source: OCC: two Cboe primaries fetched direct and parsed by this session on 2026-09-06, at this event's own initial research (docs/research/events/vix-expiration-2027-01-20.md leg 1) — the sanctioned venue for the flip, and it meets VERBATIM the promotion criterion the proposal below set for itself ('a second Cboe surface ... listing 2027-01-20 directly'). (1) cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement (302-redirects to /markets/us/futures/market-statistics/settlement/futures/daily; HTTP 200, 536,888 bytes with curl -L) carries `VX/F7 - 2027-01-20` FOUR times — twice as plain HTML table markup (`VX/F7 - 2027-01-2019.9997` and the same row at 20.1488) and twice inside the escaped React payload — i.e. this surface did NOT require unescaping to read, contrary to the note the February sibling left. (2) The machine-readable CSV www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv?dt=2026-09-04 (HTTP 200, 1,731 bytes) returns `VX,VX/F7,2027-01-20,19.9997`, and ?dt=2026-09-03 (HTTP 200, 1,733 bytes) returns `VX,VX/F7,2027-01-20,20.1488` — the two dates and two surfaces agree to the fourth decimal. `VXM/F7` (Mini VIX) is listed on both surfaces at both prices, the same extra margin that promoted the February sibling. Arithmetic cross-check, computed independently this session: 2027-01-20 is a Wednesday exactly 30 calendar days before 2027-02-19, which is February 2027's third Friday. Two Cboe surfaces plus an arithmetic check is the standard that promoted vix-expiration-2026-09-16, -2027-02-17 and -2027-03-17; OCC: is the prefix market-events-data.ts defines for exactly this ('theocc.com / Cboe; 3rd-Friday standard'). PRIOR SEEDING SOURCE, retained for audit: EST: the same CSV fetched 2026-09-06 by the opex-2027-01-15 adjacency sweep, filed estimate purely because that lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Blocked to this runner on 2026-09-06 and therefore NOT relied on: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars (403), theocc.com/company-information/schedules (403), cdn.cboe.com/.../2027_Expiration_Calendar.pdf (403). Checked 2026-09-06
notes: PROPOSED by the opex-2027-01-15 initial research (2026-09-06) at exactly +5 days inside its adjacency corridor; canonical file written by this event's own initial research (2026-09-06), which read that proposal first and shadows it. WHAT IT IS: VIX contracts AM-settle to a Special Opening Quotation (VRO) struck from the opening auction of a SINGLE SPX/SPXW series exactly 30 days out. VX/F7's reference series is therefore 2027-02-19 -- February's monthly expiration (opex-2027-02-19, estimate) -- and NOT the 2027-01-15 expiration this settlement follows. PLACEMENT (structural, recommends nothing): F7's settlement window 2027-01-21 -> 2027-02-19 CONTAINS fomc-2027-01-27 (estimate, high); VX/Z6's window 2026-12-17 -> 2027-01-15 EXCLUDES it and instead terminates ON the proposer's own expiration. A VIX future prices an expectation of its own VRO, so among listed VIX futures the JANUARY line is the January-FOMC line and the December line is not. CORRECTION TO THE PROPOSAL, made at initial research: the proposal framed 'day 7 of 30' as the inverse of the February sibling's 'day 27 of 30, heavily diluted'. That framing is WRONG -- a 30-day variance measure is additive across days, so an event day's POSITION inside the strip does not change its contribution at all. Both contracts carry one FOMC day in a 21-22 session strip and the dilution is identical; only inclusion vs exclusion matters. THE FINDING THAT JUSTIFIES A SEPARATE DOCUMENT, and it is a negative one: F7 is the only listed contract where the two mechanics the February sibling could not separate predict OPPOSITE signs -- holiday drag makes it cheap by ~0.46 pts (21 sessions vs a 22 norm, from Washington's Birthday 2027-02-15) while the in-window FOMC makes it rich by ~0.47 pts on an assumed double-variance day, netting ~+0.01. Measured, F7's log(dte)-fit residual is -0.0083 (09-04) / +0.0222 (09-03), the smallest on the curve. But a near-zero reading is exactly what BOTH 'both priced, cancelling' and 'neither priced' predict, so the opposite-sign design does NOT identify and is refused rather than banked. What DOES move: regressing residual on predicted drag across all nine contracts gives slope 0.56/0.50, but ex-Z6 it collapses to 0.22/0.18 -- one leverage point (Z6, the only two-holiday strip) carries it, and the ex-Z6 slope reproduces the ~20% two prior sessions found by different specifications. MLK 2027-01-18 IS THE HEADLINE: it falls in the five-day hole between Z6's strip (ends 01-15) and F7's (starts 01-21), making it the only US market closure INTERIOR to this listed curve's span that no listed VIX future's settlement window contains -- so the January closure is invisible to the entire VIX term structure and F7's session deficit comes from a FEBRUARY holiday. Proposed as mlk-market-closure-2027-01-18 in the same PR (estimate; the February sibling named it and declined it as out of ITS corridor). Two framings measured and DOWNGRADED to arithmetic: strips do not tile (3 five-day gaps, 5 overlaps across 8 adjacent pairs, fully determined by third-Friday spacing), and this settlement sitting inside an FOMC communications blackout is 5-of-9 on the listed curve, not distinctive. Impact LOW: one execution guard (nothing trades the 2027-01-20 opening auction), one placement note, two refusals; it licenses nothing. Dated evidence nobody trades this yet: on the hawkish 2026-09-04 payrolls print VX/F7 fell 0.1491 (-0.74%) while VIX cash rose 14.32 -> 14.53. SECOND HOLE, still open and still not this lane's: vix-expiration-2026-12-16 is directly dated on the same file (`VX,VX/Z6,2026-12-16,18.975`) and remains untracked -- recorded here so it is not lost.
